name: megascenes-christmas-wallpaper
description: Create Christmas wallpapers and backgrounds for your phone or computer, in the scene and style you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Describe the Christmas scene you want behind your apps: a snowy forest at night, a tree full of lights, gingerbread houses, a minimal pattern of stars. You get a wallpaper in the shape you need, tall for a phone or wide for a computer.

ChatGPT tells you what the wallpaper needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The image opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For phones, laptops, video call backgrounds and holiday screens.

Limitations: one image per run; it does not set the wallpaper on your device for you. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Tall for phones or wide for computers
Return the image in the chat
defaultPrompt: A Christmas phone wallpaper of a snowy forest at night with warm lights
A wide Christmas desktop background with a tree full of lights
A minimal Christmas pattern of gold stars on dark green for my phone

positive.prompt: A Christmas phone wallpaper of a snowy forest at night with warm lights. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one wallpaper needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A wide Christmas desktop background with a tree full of lights. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one background needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a Christmas wallpaper here?
positive.expected_behavior: The wallpaper models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A minimal Christmas pattern of gold stars on dark green, tall for my phone. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my wallpaper on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my wallpaper to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
